svg.title: Azure Virtual Desktop scaling plan: schedules and settings
svg.desc: A scaling plan has a time zone, host pool type, exclusion tag and one or more schedules. A pooled plan uses pooled schedules and a personal plan uses personal schedules. One plan can be assigned to many host pools of the same type. Autoscale turns the session host VMs of those host pools on and off. A pooled schedule has ramp-up, peak, ramp-down and off-peak phases with load balancing, minimum percentage of hosts, capacity threshold and force logoff settings. It repeats on the days you pick. A personal schedule has the same four phases with Start VM on Connect, disconnect and sign out actions. Related settings: the Desktop Virtualization Power On Off Contributor role for the AVD service principal or a host pool managed identity, at the subscription, the exclusion tag on session hosts, and Start VM on Connect on the host pool.
